# UAE Trail — extended machine documentation
# https://uaetrail.com/llms-full.txt

## Product summary
UAE Trail is a consumer outdoor social product: find your people, get outside, go together.
Residents, expats, tourists, and visitors use the explore map to discover real outings and places,
then RSVP or request to join host-approved plans.

## Agent integration (recommended)
1. Read https://uaetrail.com/api/agent/manifest.json for live URLs and policy.
2. Search with GET https://uaetrail.com/api/agent/discover
   - Required: q (1–64 characters)
   - Optional: kind=all|activity|place, region (emirate substring), limit (1–25, default 10)
3. Open canonical entity URLs from `results[].url` in the JSON response.
4. For rich previews / structured data on activities, crawlers may fetch
   https://uaetrail.com/og/activity/{id} (HTML with Open Graph + JSON-LD Event).

## Response shape (discover)
- schema_version: "1.0"
- query: echoed search string
- total: number of results returned
- results[]: { kind, id, title, summary, url, region?, activityType?, date?, time?, placeKind? }

## REST alternatives
- Map bundle: GET /api/explore/map (activities, venues, shops, participant demand pins)
- Activity detail: GET /api/activities/{id}
- Places list: GET /api/locations?page=1&pageSize=20

## Sitemaps
- https://uaetrail.com/sitemap.xml
- https://uaetrail.com/sitemap-activities.xml

## Boundaries
Allowed without login: /explore, entity detail pages, /faq, public /api/agent/*, public read APIs above.
Do not index or bulk-harvest: /profile, /messages, /host, /admin, /api/me/*, /api/chat/*.

## OpenAPI
When served from the API host: GET /api/openapi.json (see manifest documentation.openapi_json).
